# The gleif feed

GLEIF legal entities, ownership and identifier mappings.

The Global LEI Foundation's golden copy (level 2 relationships and reporting exceptions), the LEI records of the pack's universe from the LEI API, and the ISIN/BIC-to-LEI mapping files: core reference data for every counterparty.

| | |
|---|---|
| Source | GLEIF (https://www.gleif.org) |
| Licence | [CC0 1.0 (attribution appreciated)](https://www.gleif.org/en/meta/lei-data-terms-of-use): redistributable |
| Attribution | Contains LEI data from the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF), CC0 1.0 |
| Lake | `referencelake` (load route `java`) |
| Schedule | daily at 05:30 (local time) |
| Pull | `gleif.GleifFeed` (tools/feeds/sources/gleif.py); 1 s between requests, 3 retries |

## Run it

```bash
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run gleif --dry-run      # what it would fetch and load; changes nothing
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run gleif                # pull today, write data/datafeeds/gleif/<date>/, load into referencelake
python3 tools/drishti.py feed status gleif             # its last runs
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run gleif --snapshot     # refresh the committed demo snapshot instead
```

Daily: `python3 tools/drishti.py feed schedule --cron` (or `--systemd`, `--windows`). The guide: [FEEDS_GUIDE.md](../../docs/guides/FEEDS_GUIDE.md).

## Data contract

### lei-entity

Pack `gleif`, kind `lei-entity` (LEI legal entity), table `lei-entity`, key `LEI`; files `data/datafeeds/gleif/<date>/lei-entity.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

One legal entity: name, addresses, legal form, status, renewal.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LEI` | id | required | The entity's Legal Entity Identifier (ISO 17442): 20 characters, letters and digits; the record's key. |
| `NAME` | text | required | The entity's legal name (GLEIF entity.legalName). |
| `OTHER_NAMES` | record list | optional | The entity's other names in GLEIF (otherNames, then transliteratedOtherNames), at most two, one element each: NAME and TYPE (previous legal name, trading or operating name, …). |
| `LEGAL_FORM` | text | required | The entity's legal form, as the ISO 20275 entity legal form code's name (GLEIF legalForm), or the code itself (9999 and the like) when it has no name. |
| `JURISDICTION` | id | optional | The jurisdiction the entity is registered in, as ISO 3166-2 (US-DE, CA-QC) when it is a subdivision; absent when it is the whole country (LEI_COUNTRY). |
| `LEI_COUNTRY` | id | required | The country of the entity's legal address, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (US, GB …): a country of the computed lei-country kind. |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | text | required | The name of the legal address's country (LEI_COUNTRY), from the ISO 3166 list. |
| `LEGAL_ADDRESS` | text | required | The entity's legal address on one line: street lines, postal code, city, region and country, as GLEIF gives them. |
| `LEGAL_CITY` | text | required | The city of the legal address. |
| `HQ_ADDRESS` | text | optional | The headquarters address, one line; absent when it is the legal address. |
| `REGISTERED_AS` | text | optional | The entity's id in its registration authority's register (GLEIF entity.registeredAs). |
| `ENTITY_STATUS` | text | required | Whether the entity itself still exists: ACTIVE or INACTIVE (GLEIF entity status), or NULL as GLEIF gives it. |
| `CREATED` | date | optional | The date the legal entity was established (GLEIF entityCreationDate), YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `REGISTRATION_STATUS` | text | required | The LEI's registration status in GLEIF (ISSUED, LAPSED, RETIRED, MERGED, PENDING_TRANSFER ...). |
| `INITIAL_REGISTRATION` | date | required | The date the LEI was first issued (GLEIF initialRegistrationDate), YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `LAST_UPDATE` | date | required | The date GLEIF's record was last changed (lastUpdateDate), YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `NEXT_RENEWAL` | date | required | The date the LEI must be renewed by (nextRenewalDate), YYYY-MM-DD; a date before the retrieval date means the LEI has lapsed. |
| `RENEWAL_LATE` | boolean | required | true when the registration has lapsed or its next renewal date has passed (the record was not renewed in time). |
| `MANAGING_LOU` | text | required | The Local Operating Unit that manages the LEI (GLEIF managingLou), by name when GLEIF's list names it, else its LEI. |
| `BICS` | text | optional | The entity's BIC codes from GLEIF's BIC-to-LEI mapping file, comma separated. |
| `BIC_COUNT` | integer | optional | How many BICs map to the entity; absent when none. |
| `ISIN_COUNT` | integer | optional | How many ISINs GLEIF's ISIN-to-LEI mapping gives the entity; absent when none. |
| `LEI_GROUP` | id | required | The entity's ownership group: the LEI of its ultimate parent (the entity's own LEI when it has none), the id of the computed lei-group kind. |
| `PARENT_EXCEPTIONS` | record list | optional | Why GLEIF has no parent for the entity (its reporting exceptions), one element per level: LEVEL (Direct parent, Ultimate parent), REASON (GLEIF's code, NATURAL_PERSONS, NON_PUBLIC …) and MEANING. |
| `CHILDREN` | record list | optional | The entity's direct children that are in the pack, one element each: LEI, NAME, COUNTRY (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) and KIDS (how many children it has in turn). |
| `CHILD_COUNT` | integer | optional | How many of the entity's direct children are in the pack (CHILDREN); absent when none. |
| `DIRECT_CHILDREN_GLEIF` | integer | optional | How many entities report this one as their direct parent in GLEIF level 2 data (all of GLEIF, not only the pack). |
| `ULTIMATE_CHILDREN_GLEIF` | integer | optional | How many entities report this one as their ultimate parent in GLEIF level 2 data. |
| `GLEIF_GROUP_SIZE` | integer | optional | On an ultimate parent: its ownership group's size in GLEIF's golden copy, itself included (an input from GLEIF; the computed LEIG reads it as MEMBERS_IN_GLEIF) |
| `MAPPING_IDS` | id list | optional | The entity's identifiers in GLEIF's mapping files, kept for the seed entities and the groups' ultimate parents: its BICs, MICs and a sample of its ISINs, each an IDENTIFIER of the lei-mapping kind. |
| `SEGMENT` | text | optional | Why in this pack |
| `US_COMPANY` | id | optional | The us-equities company this entity is: a TICKER of the us-equities pack's us-company kind; absent when it is none. |
| `US_COMPANY_NAME` | text | optional | The name of the us-equities company with this LEI (US_COMPANY its ticker); empty when none. |
| `RENEWAL` | text | optional | A note on the renewal, only when it is late or due within 30 days (for example "Late: renewal was due 2024-10-07 (lapsed)"). |
| `DIRECT_PARENT` | text | optional | The LEI of the entity's direct accounting-consolidation parent, when that parent is in the pack. |
| `ULTIMATE_PARENT` | text | optional | The LEI of the entity's ultimate parent, when it is in the pack and not the direct parent. |
| `PARENTS` | record list | optional | The entity's chain of parents from the direct parent up to the ultimate parent, one element per level: LEVEL (1 is the direct parent), LEI, NAME and RELATIONSHIP. |
| `OPENCORPORATES` | text | optional | The entity's OpenCorporates id (<jurisdiction>/<company number>), from GLEIF's mapping. |
| `HQ_COUNTRY` | text | optional | The headquarters' country (ISO 3166 alpha-2), only when it differs from the legal address's. |
| `MIC` | text | optional | The market identifier codes (ISO 10383) GLEIF maps to the entity, comma-separated ("AACA, UKCA"). |
| `CATEGORY` | text | optional | The GLEIF entity category when not GENERAL: Fund, Branch, Sole proprietor ... |
| `SUCCESSOR` | text | optional | The LEI of the entity that succeeded this one (after a merger or transfer). |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE (GLEIF golden copy and mapping files), RETRIEVED_AT (YYYY-MM-DD), LICENCE (CC0) and URL (the record on search.gleif.org). |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"LEI": "HWUPKR0MPOU8FGXBT394", "NAME": "Apple Inc.", "LEGAL_FORM": "For-Profit Corporation General Stock", "JURISDICTION": "US-CA", "LEI_COUNTRY": "US", "COUNTRY_NAME": "United States of America (the)", "LEGAL_ADDRESS": "C/O C T Corporation System, 330 N. Brand Blvd, Suite 700, 9…", "LEGAL_CITY": "Glendale", "HQ_ADDRESS": "One Apple Park Way, 95014 Cupertino, US-CA, US", "REGISTERED_AS": "806592", "ENTITY_STATUS": "ACTIVE", "CREATED": "1977-01-03", "REGISTRATION_STATUS": "ISSUED", "INITIAL_REGISTRATION": "2012-06-06", "LAST_UPDATE": "2026-03-03", "NEXT_RENEWAL": "2027-03-08", "RENEWAL_LATE": false, "MANAGING_LOU": "Bloomberg Finance L.P.", "BICS": "APLEUS66XXX", "BIC_COUNT": 1, "ISIN_COUNT": 949, "LEI_GROUP": "HWUPKR0MPOU8FGXBT394", "CHILD_COUNT": 8, "DIRECT_CHILDREN_GLEIF": 8, "ULTIMATE_CHILDREN_GLEIF": 20, "GLEIF_GROUP_SIZE": 173, "SEGMENT": "US equities", "US_COMPANY": "AAPL", "US_COMPANY_NAME": "Apple Inc.", "RENEWAL": "Late: renewal was due 2024-10-07 (lapsed)", "DIRECT_PARENT": "549300COKYB5EGSU1838", "ULTIMATE_PARENT": "549300B2Q47IR0CR5B54", "OPENCORPORATES": "nl/34153487", "HQ_COUNTRY": "US", "MIC": "MAQI", "CATEGORY": "Fund", "SUCCESSOR": "724500ZSA7ZOZHUXBS53"}
```

The contract: `config/packs/gleif/contracts/lei-entity.contract.yaml` ([gleif](../../docs/contracts/packs/gleif.md)).

### lei-relationship

Pack `gleif`, kind `lei-relationship` (LEI parent relationship), table `lei-relationship`, key `RELATIONSHIP_ID`; files `data/datafeeds/gleif/<date>/lei-relationship.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

A direct or ultimate parent relationship (level 2).

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RELATIONSHIP_ID` | id | required | The record's id (the business key) |
| `LEVEL` | text | required | Direct (the child's direct parent) or Ultimate (its ultimate parent). |
| `CHILD_ENTITY` | id | required | The child in the relationship: an LEI of the lei-entity kind (20 characters). |
| `PARENT_ENTITY` | id | required | The parent in the relationship (direct or ultimate, per LEVEL): an LEI of the lei-entity kind. |
| `RELATIONSHIP_STATUS` | text | required | Whether the relationship holds: ACTIVE or INACTIVE (GLEIF relationship status). |
| `START` | date | required | The date the relationship started (the GLEIF relationship record's period start), YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `END` | date | optional | The date the relationship ended (the GLEIF relationship record's period end); absent while it holds. |
| `PERIODS` | record list | required | The relationship's other periods in GLEIF (the accounting period and the document filing period of the consolidation), one element each: TYPE, START and END. |
| `REGISTRATION_STATUS` | text | required | The relationship record's registration status in GLEIF (PUBLISHED, LAPSED ...). |
| `INITIAL_REGISTRATION` | date | required | The date the relationship record was first registered with GLEIF, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `LAST_UPDATE` | date | required | The date GLEIF's relationship record was last changed, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `NEXT_RENEWAL` | date | required | The date the relationship record must be renewed by, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `LEI_GROUP` | id | required | The child's ownership group: the LEI of its ultimate parent, the id of the computed lei-group kind. |
| `ACCOUNTING_STANDARD` | text | optional | The accounting standard of the consolidation the relationship is based on (IFRS, US_GAAP, OTHER_ACCOUNTING_STANDARD), comma-separated when several. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"RELATIONSHIP_ID": "LEIREL-010PWNH4K3BLIC3I7R03-DIRECT", "LEVEL": "Direct", "CHILD_ENTITY": "010PWNH4K3BLIC3I7R03", "PARENT_ENTITY": "549300COKYB5EGSU1838", "RELATIONSHIP_STATUS": "ACTIVE", "START": "2017-12-06", "END": "2025-06-30", "REGISTRATION_STATUS": "LAPSED", "INITIAL_REGISTRATION": "2023-08-08", "LAST_UPDATE": "2024-10-07", "NEXT_RENEWAL": "2024-10-07", "LEI_GROUP": "549300B2Q47IR0CR5B54", "ACCOUNTING_STANDARD": "IFRS"}
```

The contract: `config/packs/gleif/contracts/lei-relationship.contract.yaml` ([gleif](../../docs/contracts/packs/gleif.md)).

### lei-mapping

Pack `gleif`, kind `lei-mapping` (ISIN or BIC to LEI), table `lei-mapping`, key `IDENTIFIER`; files `data/datafeeds/gleif/<date>/lei-mapping.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

An ISIN or BIC mapped to its LEI.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `IDENTIFIER` | id | required | The identifier GLEIF maps to an LEI: an ISIN (12 characters), a BIC (8 or 11) or a MIC (4); the record's key. |
| `TYPE` | text | required | What IDENTIFIER is: ISIN, BIC or MIC (the mapping file it came from). |
| `ENTITY_LEI` | id | required | The entity the identifier belongs to: an LEI of the lei-entity kind (20 characters). |
| `ENTITY_NAME` | text | required | The legal name of that entity, as in its GLEIF record. |
| `COUNTRY` | text | required | The legal address country of the entity the identifier maps to (ISO 3166 alpha-2). |
| `LEI_GROUP` | id | required | The entity's ownership group: the LEI of its ultimate parent, the id of the computed lei-group kind. |
| `MAPPING_FILE` | text | required | The GLEIF mapping file the pair was read from (isin-lei-…, LEI-BIC-…, LEI-MIC-….zip), which dates it. |
| `ISIN_COUNT` | integer | optional | ISINs of the issuer |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"IDENTIFIER": "WABTUS3WXXX", "TYPE": "BIC", "ENTITY_LEI": "06BTX5UWZD0GQ5N5Y745", "ENTITY_NAME": "WESTINGHOUSE AIR BRAKE TECHNOLOGIES CORPORATION", "COUNTRY": "US", "LEI_GROUP": "06BTX5UWZD0GQ5N5Y745", "MAPPING_FILE": "LEI-BIC-20260925.zip", "ISIN_COUNT": 909}
```

The contract: `config/packs/gleif/contracts/lei-mapping.contract.yaml` ([gleif](../../docs/contracts/packs/gleif.md)).
